9.t: on the Day when the sky sways back and forth

11.t: Woe on that Day to those who deny the Truth,

12.t: who amuse themselves with idle chatter:

13.t: on that Day they will be thrust into the Fire of Hell.

14.t: ‘This is the Fire you used to deny.

15.t: So is this sorcery? Do you still not see it?

16.t: Burn in it––it makes no difference whether you bear it patiently or not–– you are only being repaid for what you have done.’

17.t: Those who were mindful of God are in Gardens and in bliss,

18.t: rejoicing in their Lord’s gifts: He has saved them from the torment of the Blaze,

19.t: ‘Eat and drink with healthy enjoyment as a reward for what you have done.’

20.t: They are comfortably seated on couches arranged in rows; We pair them with beautiful-eyed maidens;

21.t: We unite the believers with their offspring who followed them in faith–– We do not deny them any of the rewards for their deeds: each person is in pledge for his own deeds––

22.t: We provide them with any fruit or meat they desire.

23.t: They pass around a cup which does not lead to any idle talk or sin.

24.t: Devoted youths like hidden pearls wait on them.

25.t: They turn to one another and say,

26.t: ‘When we were still with our families [on earth] we used to live in fear––

27.t: God has been gracious to us and saved us from the torment of intense heat-

28.t: We used to pray to Him: He is the Good, the Merciful One.’

29.t: So [Prophet] remind [people]. By the grace of your Lord [Prophet], you are neither oracle nor madman.

30.t: If they say, ‘He is only a poet: we shall await his fate,’

31.t: say, ‘Wait if you wish; I too am waiting’-

32.t: does their reason really tell them to do this, or are they simply insolent people?

33.t: If they say, ‘He has made it up himself’- they certainly do not believe-

34.t: let them produce one like it, if what they say is true.

35.t: Were they created without any agent? Were they the creators?

36.t: Did they create the heavens and the earth? No! They do not have faith.

37.t: Do they possess your Lord’s treasures or have control over them?

38.t: Do they have a ladder to climb, in order to eavesdrop [on Heaven’s secrets]? Let their eavesdropper produce clear proof.

39.t: Does God have daughters while you have sons?

40.t: Do you [Prophet] demand a payment from them that would burden them with debt?

41.t: Do they have [access to] the unseen? Could they write it down?

42.t: Do they think they can ensnare you? It is the disbelievers who have been ensnared.

43.t: Do they really have another god besides God? God is far above anything they set alongside Him.

44.t: Even if they saw a piece of heaven falling down on them, they would say, ‘Just a heap of clouds,’

45.t: so leave them, Prophet, until they face the Day when they will be thunderstruck,

46.t: the Day when their snares will be of no use to them, when they will get no help.

47.t: Another punishment awaits the evildoers, though most of them do not realize it.

48.t: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: you are under Our watchful eye. Celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise.

49.t: Glorify Him at night and at the fading of the stars.
